summary: Preinstall Bun-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload in docs-only package
details: @umacloud/knowledge advertises itself as a markdown knowledge corpus, and its package.json `files` field allow-lists only `**/*.md`. The tarball nonetheless ships two undeclared root-level JavaScript blobs, setup.mjs and math_init.js, and declares a `preinstall` hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e` style identifiers with decoy objects) and downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13 zip) from GitHub releases into a temp directory, extracts it, chmods the binary to 0755, and invokes it via execFileSync against the bundled math_init.js. math_init.js is a heavily obfuscated single-line 727KB bundle beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs` and using string-array rotation packing (`function WV8StW(...){for(...)MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift());return MmgoCP}`) that requires the Bun runtime to execute, evading Node-based scanners. The Bun runtime and the executed payload are unrelated to the package's stated markdown-corpus purpose, and both the loader and the payload are obfuscated to hide their behavior. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: an unrelated package pulls a non-default runtime at preinstall solely to execute a bundled opaque payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
